query:
UPDATE authors SET
                name = $2,
                normalized_name = $3,
                identifiers = identifiers || $4,
                images = images || $5,
                bio = COALESCE($6, bio),
                is_monitored = COALESCE($7, is_monitored),
                auto_want_mode = CASE
                    WHEN $8::text IS NOT NULL AND $8::text != 'none' THEN $8::text
                    ELSE auto_want_mode
                END,
                known_book_count = COALESCE($9, known_book_count),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
